datasets.name: user_loyalty_segments
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      reorder_rate_percent >= 0
      AND reorder_rate_percent < 25
    THEN
      '0-25%'
    WHEN
      reorder_rate_percent >= 25
      AND reorder_rate_percent < 50
    THEN
      '25-50%'
    WHEN
      reorder_rate_percent >= 50
      AND reorder_rate_percent < 75
    THEN
      '50-75%'
    ELSE '75-100%'
  END AS reorder_rate_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count,
  AVG(avg_days_between_orders) AS avg_days_between_orders
FROM
  resume_project.gold.gold_user_behavior
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN
      reorder_rate_percent >= 0
      AND reorder_rate_percent < 25
    THEN
      '0-25%'
    WHEN
      reorder_rate_percent >= 25
      AND reorder_rate_percent < 50
    THEN
      '25-50%'
    WHEN
      reorder_rate_percent >= 50
      AND reorder_rate_percent < 75
    THEN
      '50-75%'
    ELSE '75-100%'
  END
ORDER BY
  user_count DESC

datasets.name: avg_user_reorder_rate
queryLines:
SELECT
  AVG(reorder_rate_percent) AS avg_reorder_rate
FROM
  resume_project.gold.gold_user_behavior

datasets.name: avg_days_between_orders
queryLines:
SELECT
  AVG(avg_days_between_orders) AS avg_days
FROM
  resume_project.gold.gold_user_behavior

datasets.name: days_distribution
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders >= 0
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 7
    THEN
      '0-7 days'
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders > 7
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 14
    THEN
      '8-14 days'
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders > 14
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 21
    THEN
      '15-21 days'
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders > 21
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 30
    THEN
      '22-30 days'
    ELSE '31+ days'
  END AS days_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM
  resume_project.gold.gold_user_behavior
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders >= 0
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 7
    THEN
      '0-7 days'
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders > 7
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 14
    THEN
      '8-14 days'
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders > 14
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 21
    THEN
      '15-21 days'
    WHEN
      avg_days_between_orders > 21
      AND avg_days_between_orders <= 30
    THEN
      '22-30 days'
    ELSE '31+ days'
  END
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN days_bucket = '0-7 days' THEN 1
    WHEN days_bucket = '8-14 days' THEN 2
    WHEN days_bucket = '15-21 days' THEN 3
    WHEN days_bucket = '22-30 days' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END

datasets.name: most_common_pair
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT(product_1, ' + ', product_2) AS product_pair,
  times_bought_together
FROM
  resume_project.gold.gold_product_pairs
ORDER BY
  times_bought_together DESC
LIMIT 1
